# authoring-tools

Guidance for authoring Claude Code extensions. Claude-only by nature — the content documents Claude Code's own formats.

Version: **0.8.1**

## Skills

Both skills target Claude Code only (`targets: [claude]`) and are manual-only: `disable-model-invocation: true` prevents automatic loading. Invoke them explicitly with the commands below.

| Skill | Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| creating-skills | `/authoring-tools:creating-skills` | Create, write, and refine Claude Code Skills |
| creating-agents | `/authoring-tools:creating-agents` | Design and implement Claude Code subagents and multi-agent workflows |

> Generated from this repo's `src/plugins/authoring-tools/` sources — edit there, not in `dist/`.
